clue.text: Travelling enables me to leave out a group

indicators.note: travelling letters move about, so the words enables me are rearranged, with the a in the clue dropped from them

explanation.surface: Someone sets off on a journey and agrees to be left out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Travelling' scrambles ENABLES ME, and 'to leave out' tells you the letter A in the clue comes out of that pool, leaving eight letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: An ensemble is a band of musicians or performers working together.

clue.text: Worried by more primitive being

indicators.note: worried things are disturbed, so the letters of by and more are jumbled

explanation.surface: A primitive creature is fretting more and more.
explanation.definitionFit: An organism at its earliest stage of development.

clue.text: The way to wheel and walk

parts.note: St is short for street, a way
to wheel is to roll

explanation.surface: Instructions for pushing a bike along a road on foot.
explanation.definitionFit: A leisurely amble on foot.

clue.text: Coins whipped from side-room

indicators.note: whipped suggests beaten up, so the letters of side-room are rearranged

explanation.surface: Money stolen from a small back room.
explanation.definitionFit: Old Portuguese gold coins once current in England.

clue.text: Advance look at article

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look!
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Examine an article before putting money up front.
explanation.definitionFit: Money lent, an advance of funds.

clue.text: Seafood emus seldom eat

indicators.note: eat here suggests the letters are taken in, swallowed inside the run emus seldom

explanation.surface: A note that big flightless birds rarely dine on shellfish.
explanation.definitionFit: This bivalve shellfish is commonly served as seafood, steamed in wine.

clue.text: Capsizes and causes distress

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: tips something over, and makes someone unhappy.

clue.text: Risk his mate is initially prepared to encounter

indicators.note: prepared means made ready, so these letters are worked into a new arrangement
initially takes just the opening letter of mate

explanation.surface: A man gets ready to risk his friend in a clash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' gives M from mate, which joins RISK HIS in the pool 'prepared' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief fight or clash, an encounter between small forces.

clue.text: Novel — it rarely is well read

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters of it rarely are made into a new word

explanation.surface: A book that is seldom read thoroughly.
explanation.definitionFit: Knowing a great deal about books and writing.

clue.text: Horse I'm able to place in London

parts.note: a barb is a breed of horse from North Africa
I'm able means I can

explanation.surface: A horse that is fit to compete somewhere in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: The Barbican is an area of the City of London, home to a well-known arts centre.
explanation.definitionFit: A district of the City of London with a large estate and arts centre.

clue.text: Help needed — grass is too high, needs cutting

indicators.note: the words are trimmed at both ends, so a run is cut out from inside grass is too high

explanation.surface: A gardener complains the lawn is overgrown and someone must lend a hand.
explanation.definitionFit: To assist someone is to aid them; as a noun it also means aid.

clue.text: Render first aid

definitions.meaning: to coat a wall with a smooth layer
a sticking dressing for a small cut

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: coating a wall with a smooth layer, and an adhesive dressing for a wound.

clue.text: Colour, as some do when hurt?

parts.note: people who are hurt shout out loud
the cry of pain people give is ow

explanation.surface: Asking which shade people turn when injured, like a bruise.
explanation.definitionFit: A primary hue, the shade of lemons and egg yolks.

clue.text: A grandfather clock for the pensioner?

definitions.meaning: a long-case clock, an aged timekeeper
an elderly retired person, a veteran

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a timepiece of great age, and an elderly person who has been around a long while.

clue.text: A link with reproduction

definitions.meaning: a machine part linking a turning shaft to its support
giving birth to or producing offspring

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a machine part supporting a rotating shaft, and the carrying or giving birth to young.

clue.text: Free film showing?

definitions.meaning: to set at liberty, a verb
the putting out of a new movie to cinemas

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: to let go or liberate, and the launch of a new movie to the public.

clue.text: Legal right sure to be flung out

indicators.note: flinging out throws things about, so the letters of sure are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A claimed entitlement that is certain to be thrown out of court.
explanation.walkthrough: In law, 'user' is the continued use or enjoyment of a right, such as a right of way.
explanation.definitionFit: A lawyer's term for the exercise of a right over time, giving a claim to it.

clue.text: Put out, although established it's acceptable to be put inside

indicators.note: the acceptable word goes inside the established word

parts.note: to prove something is to establish it
OK says something is acceptable

explanation.surface: Someone is annoyed though it is shown to be fine for them to be jailed.
explanation.definitionFit: Annoyed or irritated, put out.

clue.text: Pitiful way to allude to uprising

parts.note: a path is a way

indicators.note: in a down clue an uprising reads from the bottom up, turning the word round

parts.note: to cite something is to refer or allude to it

explanation.surface: A feeble method of hinting at a rebellion.
explanation.definitionFit: Arousing pity or contempt, feeble.

clue.text: Bear hugs an accountant holding leaves

indicators.note: the bear embraces the article and the accountant, putting them inside

parts.note: a teddy is a toy bear
an gives the letter A
CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: A toy bear hugs an accountant who is clutching leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a container for tea leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: A small box or tin for storing tea.

clue.text: Gather salesman is to accept article

indicators.note: accepting takes something in, so the article goes inside the salesman

parts.note: rep is short for a sales representative
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A salesman agrees to take an item on.
explanation.definitionFit: To harvest a crop is to gather it in.

clue.text: Blood-stained after getting cheese tied up with something scratchy

indicators.note: the colour word is placed after the cheese

parts.note: brie is a soft French cheese
blood-stained things are coloured red

explanation.surface: Someone bleeding after a cheese course got snagged on a thorny bush.
explanation.definitionFit: Caught or tangled up in thorny wild-rose bushes.

clue.text: I conclude imprisoning the politician is about to happen

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament
to end is to conclude

explanation.surface: Someone says they will finish by jailing the politician very soon.
explanation.definitionFit: To loom or hang over as something imminent.

clue.text: Stop academic revealing your ancestry

parts.note: to stem a flow is to stop it
an MA is a Master of Arts, an academic

explanation.surface: Stop a scholar from uncovering your family history.
explanation.definitionFit: A family tree or line of descent.

clue.text: About the foreign currency -it has been declared

parts.note: re means about or concerning
the mark was the former German currency

explanation.surface: A statement concerning foreign money has been announced.
explanation.definitionFit: A comment is something said or stated aloud.

clue.text: Check out machismo characters go through, being forceful

indicators.note: the he-men pass through the middle of the vetting word

parts.note: to vet is to examine or check out
he-men are macho, muscular characters

explanation.surface: A machismo test that tough characters pass, showing their strength.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing intense passion or strength of feeling.

clue.text: Chesty disorder? Cut down the grass!

indicators.note: a disorder puts things out of their proper arrangement, so chesty is shuffled

explanation.surface: Someone with a chest complaint is told to go and mow the lawn.
explanation.definitionFit: To mow with a long curved blade on a pole, a verb.

clue.text: Search begins for animal now it's lighter

indicators.note: begins takes only the opening letter of search

parts.note: a cow is a farm animal

explanation.surface: A hunt starts for a beast now that it is getting light.
explanation.walkthrough: A lighter is a flat-bottomed barge, which a scow also is.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat-bottomed boat for carrying cargo, like a barge.

clue.text: Youngster seen to score half-way through, after tackle

indicators.note: the half-score comes after the equipment word

parts.note: kit is equipment, like fishing tackle
a score is twenty, and half of that is ten

explanation.surface: A young footballer scores at half-time after a tackle.
explanation.definitionFit: A baby cat, a young animal.

clue.text: Set one's sight on a first class — alpha -—- but rebuffed in university circles

indicators.note: rebuffed means pushed back, so the whole string is read backwards

parts.note: to aim is to set one's sight on, past tense aimed

indicators.note: first marks just the opening letter of class

parts.note: alpha is the first Greek letter, giving A

explanation.surface: A student aiming at a first-class degree is turned down by the university.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rebuffed' turns the whole string AIMED A C A round.
explanation.definitionFit: The academic world, the community of scholars at universities.

clue.text: Resolve to make banker bring in investigators

indicators.note: the investigators are placed inside the river

parts.note: a banker in crosswords is a river, here the Dee
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department

explanation.surface: Police resolve to call detectives in to look at a bank official.
explanation.walkthrough: The Dee is a British river; a 'banker' is something with banks.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle or determine something, to make up one's mind.

clue.text: Persuade to lay a bet — bringing trouble for the horses

parts.note: to sway someone is to persuade them
to back a horse is to bet on it

explanation.surface: Talked into betting on the races, a gambler ends up in trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A condition in horses where the back sags abnormally.
